title: Practice
description: Three graded past-paper-style input validation questions.

questions.title: Practice 1 - Validate a Competition Score
questions.task: A competition score must be an integer from 0 to 20 inclusive. Write pseudocode to input a score and continue asking for the score until a valid value is entered.
expectedThinking: This is a range validation problem
Invalid values are below 0 or above 20
Use a loop to repeat input while invalid

markScheme.criterion: Uses clear invalid message or correction flow

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE score : INTEGER

INPUT score

WHILE score < 0 OR score > 20
    OUTPUT "Invalid score"
    INPUT score
ENDWHILE

questions.title: Practice 2 - Validate a Product Code
questions.task: A product code must be exactly 6 characters long. Write pseudocode to input the product code and keep asking for it until the length is valid.
expectedThinking: This is a length validation problem
Use LENGTH to check the number of characters
Repeat input while the length is not 6

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE productCode : STRING

INPUT productCode

WHILE LENGTH(productCode) <> 6
    OUTPUT "Invalid product code"
    INPUT productCode
ENDWHILE

questions.title: Practice 3 - Validate Menu Choice and Quantity
questions.task: A user must enter a menu choice from 1 to 4 and a quantity from 1 to 50. Write pseudocode to validate both values separately before they are accepted.
expectedThinking: There are two separate validation checks
Validate menu choice using range 1 to 4
Each value needs its own loop or validation structure

markScheme.criterion: Correct validation for choice range 1 to 4
Correct validation for quantity range 1 to 50

assessment.expectedAnswer:
DECLARE choice, quantity : INTEGER

INPUT choice
WHILE choice < 1 OR choice > 4
    OUTPUT "Invalid choice"
    INPUT choice
ENDWHILE

INPUT quantity
WHILE quantity < 1 OR quantity > 50
    OUTPUT "Invalid quantity"
    INPUT quantity
ENDWHILE
